# ARTICLE XVI-W.2 WORKING PENNSYLVANIANS TAX CREDIT

**Section 1602-W.2. Definitions**

The article defines "Department" as the Department of Revenue, "Federal earned income tax credit" as the credit under 26 U.S.C. § 32, "Qualified taxpayer" as one eligible under section 1604-W.2, "Tax credit" as the working Pennsylvanians credit, "Tax liability" as liability under Article III of the Tax Reform Code of 1971, and "Taxpayer" as an individual subject to Article III tax.

**Section 1603-W.2. Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit**

The credit applies against qualified tax liability. For spouses filing separately on a joint Federal return, only the spouse with greater tax due may claim it. The credit amount equals: *"10% of the Federal earned income tax credit received by the taxpayer for the same taxable year."*

The credit is refundable—*"if the amount of credit which the qualified taxpayer is eligible to receive under this section exceeds the qualified taxpayer's tax liability, the department shall refund the excess amount to the qualified taxpayer."*

**Section 1604-W.2. Eligibility**

*"A taxpayer is eligible to receive a tax credit if the taxpayer claimed the Federal earned income tax credit during the same taxable year."*

**Section 1606-W.2. Applicability**

*"This article shall apply to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024."*
